evals.prompt: Have a look at the ndservices/booking-api repo and tell me how the availability endpoint works.
evals.expected_output: Does not run curl, gh repo view or git ls-remote to check the repo exists first. Calls add_repo with owner and repo as separate fields, runs the clone command it returns, then calls register_repo_root with the clone path. Reads the actual code before answering.

evals.prompt: I tried getting Claude to work on our private analytics repo and it said the repo doesn't exist. It definitely does.
evals.expected_output: Explains that an unauthenticated pre-check returns 404 for a private repo even when access is authorised, so the 404 was not evidence. Says to attach with add_repo and trust its structured result. Names the two real remedies if that is genuinely denied: an organisation owner granting access at claude.ai/admin-settings/claude-tag, or reconnecting GitHub under claude.ai Settings then Connectors.

evals.prompt: What repos can you actually get at in this session?
evals.expected_output: Calls list_repos rather than answering from the session scope text or from memory, and reports what it returns. Does not declare anything inaccessible without having listed.

evals.prompt: This is a web session on opuslearning. I need you to also read a config file from my other repo, nd-services/site. Just read it, don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: Attaches with access set to read rather than push, since only reading is needed. Clones, registers the repo root, then reads the file. Does not ask for push access to make the attach succeed.

evals.prompt: Set me up so future web sessions can reach all my private repos without me attaching them each time.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes the two levers: installing the Claude GitHub App on the repositories, or running /web-setup locally to send the gh CLI token. Recommends one based on whether the user already uses gh. Mentions the Quick web setup toggle for Team and Enterprise plans. Does not claim it can change the account settings itself.

evals.prompt: While you're in there, have a quick look at the upstream fork this repo came from and see if they fixed the same bug.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently search outside the session's granted scope. Treats the fork as a separate repository needing its own attach, and either attaches it or says what is needed. Does not use a repo-agnostic search tool to reach outside scope.
